deskyard mouse-up: release a mouse button

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] mouse-up [left|right|middle]

Releases a mouse button pressed with mouse-down.

Arguments:
  BUTTON     enum        optional  mouse button (left, right, middle); default left

Prints: nothing

Examples:
  deskyard mouse-up

Where: inside a computer it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen computer (-c COMPUTER)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the desktop
